ei.title: Reexamine the Stereotype that Introverts Are Less Effective
ei.subject: 11월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Reexamine the Stereotype that Introverts Are Less Effective

fullPassage: Introverted leaders do have to overcome the strong cultural presumption that extroverts are more effective leaders. Although the population splits into almost equal parts between introverts and extroverts, more than 96 percent of managers and executives are extroverted. In a study done in 2006, 65 percent of senior corporate executives viewed introversion as a barrier to leadership. We must reexamine this stereotype, however, as it doesn’t always hold true. Regent University found that a desire to be of service to others and to empower them to grow, which is more common among introverts than extroverts, is a key factor in becoming a leader and retaining leadership. So-called servant leadership, dating back to ancient philosophical literature, adheres to the belief that a company’s goals are best achieved by helping workers or customers achieve their goals. Such leaders do not seek attention but rather want to shine a light on others’ wins and achievements; servant leadership requires humility, but that humility ultimately pays off.

questions.passage: Introverted leaders do have to overcome the strong cultural presumption that extroverts are more ①<u>effective</u> leaders. Although the population splits into almost equal parts between introverts and extroverts, more than 96 percent of managers and executives are extroverted. In a study ②<u>doing</u> in 2006, 65 percent of senior corporate executives viewed introversion as a barrier to leadership. We must reexamine this stereotype, however, as it doesn’t always hold true. Regent University found that a desire to be of service to others and to empower them to grow, which is more common among introverts than extroverts, is a key factor in becoming a leader and ③<u>retaining</u> leadership. So-called servant leadership, dating back to ancient philosophical literature, adheres to the belief that a company’s goals are best ④<u>achieved</u> by helping workers or customers achieve their goals. Such leaders do not seek attention but rather want to shine a light on others’ wins and achievements; servant leadership requires humility, but that humility ultimately pays off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② doing → done: a study done in 2006 — 과거분사의 후치수식 (완료/수동)
det.analysis:
❌ ① effective: more effective leaders — 형용사 적절

✅ ② doing: a study doing in 2006 → a study done(과거분사 후치수식) ← 정답

❌ ③ retaining: becoming a leader and retaining leadership — and 병렬 동명사 적절

❌ ④ achieved: goals are best achieved — 수동태 적절
det.tip: a study done in 2006: 과거분사(done)가 명사(study) 뒤에서 수동 의미로 수식

questions.passage: Introverted leaders do have ①<u>to overcome</u> the strong cultural presumption that extroverts are more effective leaders. Although the population splits into almost equal parts between introverts and extroverts, more than 96 percent of managers and executives are extroverted. In a study done in 2006, 65 percent of senior corporate executives ②<u>viewed</u> introversion as a barrier to leadership. We must reexamine this stereotype, however, as it doesn’t always hold true. Regent University found that a desire to be of service to others and to empower them to grow, which is more common among introverts than extroverts, is a key factor in becoming a leader and retaining leadership. So-called servant leadership, dating back to ancient philosophical literature, adheres to the belief that a company’s goals are best achieved by ③<u>helping</u> workers or customers achieve their goals. Such leaders do not seek attention ④<u>and</u> rather want to shine a light on others’ wins and achievements; servant leadership requires humility, but that humility ultimately pays off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ and → but: do not seek attention but rather want — not A but B 구문
det.analysis:
❌ ① to overcome: have to overcome — to부정사 적절

❌ ② viewed: viewed introversion as — 과거형 적절

❌ ③ helping: by helping — 전치사 뒤 동명사 적절

✅ ④ and: do not seek attention and rather want → not A but (rather) B 구문이므로 but 필요 ← 정답
det.tip: not A but (rather) B = A가 아니라 오히려 B

questions.passage: Introverted leaders do have to overcome the strong cultural presumption ①<u>that</u> extroverts are more effective leaders. In a study done in 2006, 65 percent of senior corporate executives viewed introversion as a barrier to leadership. We must reexamine this stereotype, however, as it doesn’t always hold true. Regent University found that a desire to be of service to others and to empower them to grow, which ③<u>are</u> more common among introverts than extroverts, is a key factor in becoming a leader and retaining leadership. So-called servant leadership, ④<u>dating</u> back to ancient philosophical literature, adheres to the belief that a company’s goals are best achieved by helping workers or customers achieve their goals. Such leaders do not seek attention but rather want to shine a light on others’ wins and achievements; servant leadership requires humility, but that humility ultimately pays off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ are → is: 주어가 'a desire to be of service to others and to empower them to grow'로 단수 주어(a desire)
det.analysis:
❌ ① that: the cultural presumption that — 동격의 that절 적절

❌ ② splits: the population splits — 주어-동사 수일치 적절

✅ ③ are: 주어 a desire(단수) → is 필요. 관계절(which is more common...) 삽입에 속지 말 것 ← 정답

❌ ④ dating: 분사구문(dating back to ~) 적절
det.tip: 긴 주어+관계절 삽입 시 핵심 주어(a desire = 단수)에 동사 일치

questions.passage: Introverted leaders do have to overcome the strong cultural presumption that extroverts are more effective leaders. In a study done in 2006, 65 percent of senior corporate executives viewed introversion as a ①<u>gateway</u> to leadership. We must reexamine this stereotype, however, as it doesn’t always hold true. Regent University found that a desire to be of service to others and to ②<u>empower</u> them to grow, which is more common among introverts than extroverts, is a key factor in becoming a leader and retaining leadership. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① gateway → barrier: 65%의 임원이 내향성을 리더십의 '장벽'으로 보았다는 문맥
det.analysis:
✅ ① gateway(관문, 통로): 내향성을 리더십의 장벽으로 봤다 → barrier(장벽) ← 정답

❌ ② empower: 역량을 부여하다 — 타인을 성장시킨다는 맥락 적절

❌ ③ achieved: goals are best achieved — 달성되다 적절

❌ ④ humility: 겸손 — servant leadership에 필요 적절
det.tip: barrier(장벽) ↔ gateway(관문): 정반대 의미

questions.passage: Introverted leaders do have to overcome the strong cultural ①<u>presumption</u> that extroverts are more effective leaders. Although the population splits into almost equal parts between introverts and extroverts, more than 96 percent of managers and executives are extroverted. So-called servant leadership, dating back to ancient philosophical literature, adheres to the belief that a company’s goals are best achieved by helping workers or customers achieve their goals. Such leaders do not seek ③<u>anonymity</u> but rather want to shine a light on others’ wins and achievements; servant leadership requires humility, but that humility ultimately ④<u>pays off</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ anonymity → attention: servant leader는 관심을 구하지 않는다(do not seek attention)는 문맥
det.analysis:
❌ ① presumption: 선입견 — 외향적 리더가 효과적이라는 문화적 선입견 적절

❌ ② reexamine: 재검토하다 — 고정관념을 재검토해야 한다 적절

✅ ③ anonymity(익명성): do not seek anonymity but rather want to shine a light → '관심(attention)'을 구하지 않는다가 원문 ← 정답

❌ ④ pays off: 보상받다 — 겸손이 결국 보상받는다 적절
det.tip: seek attention(관심을 구하다) vs seek anonymity(익명을 추구하다): 문맥상 '관심을 구하지 않는다'가 자연스러움

Regent University found that a desire to be of service to others and to empower them to grow, which is more common among introverts than extroverts, is __________. So-called servant leadership, dating back to ancient philosophical literature, adheres to the belief that a company’s goals are best achieved by helping workers or customers achieve their goals. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ 리더가 되고 리더십을 유지하는 데 핵심 요소
det.analysis:
❌ ① innate confidence in leadership (리더십에 대한 타고난 자신감) — 본문에 없는 개념

❌ ② statistical evidence of extroversion (외향성의 통계적 증거) — 앞부분 논거이지 빈칸 내용 아님

❌ ③ a barrier to corporate success (기업 성공의 장벽) — 반대 의미

✅ ④ a key factor in becoming a leader and retaining leadership — Regent 대학 발견: 봉사 욕구가 리더십의 핵심 요소 ← 정답
det.tip: a key factor in becoming a leader = 리더가 되는 핵심 요소

ch: a key factor in becoming a leader and retaining leadership

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 다른 사람의 성과와 업적에 빛을 비추다
det.analysis:
✅ ① shine a light on others’ wins and achievements (타인의 성과에 조명) — do not seek attention but rather want to _____ ← 정답

❌ ② overcome the strong cultural presumption (문화적 선입견 극복) — 앞부분 내용이라 빈칸(후반부) 문맥 부적절

❌ ③ become more extroverted over time (점차 외향적) — 내향적 리더의 장점 논지에 반함

❌ ④ seek attention from their followers (추종자 관심 추구) — do not seek attention과 정면 모순
det.tip: but rather = 오히려 ~하다. seek attention의 반대 행동이 빈칸에 와야 함

ch: shine a light on others’ wins and achievements

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 경영자와 임원 중 96% 이상이 외향적이다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 인구의 대다수가 외향적 (×, almost equal parts 즉 거의 반반)

❌ ② 내향성이 리더십에 유리 (×, viewed introversion as a barrier)

✅ ③ 경영자와 임원 96%+ 외향적 — 원문: more than 96 percent of managers and executives are extroverted ← 정답

❌ ④ 현대 경영학에서 처음 등장 (×, dating back to ancient philosophical literature)
det.tip: 96 percent of managers and executives are extroverted

ch: 섬김의 리더십은 현대 경영학에서 처음 등장했다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ② 자신의 업적을 부각시키려 한다: 원문은 do not seek attention but rather want to shine a light on others’ wins
det.analysis:
❌ ① 문화적 선입견 극복 — 원문: have to overcome the strong cultural presumption 일치

✅ ② 자신의 업적 부각 (×, 타인의 성과에 조명: shine a light on others’ wins) ← 정답

❌ ③ 타인 섬김 욕구=리더십 핵심 — 원문: a desire to be of service to others... is a key factor 일치

❌ ④ 겸손 요구 — 원문: servant leadership requires humility 일치
det.tip: others’ wins and achievements ≠ 자신의 업적

ch: 내향적 리더는 문화적 선입견을 극복해야 한다.
섬김의 리더십을 실천하는 지도자는 자신의 업적을 부각시키려 한다.
Regent University는 타인을 섬기려는 욕구가 리더십의 핵심 요소임을 발견했다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 외향적 리더십 우월 고정관념은 재검토가 필요하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 외향적 사람의 봉사 욕구가 더 강하다 (×, more common among introverts)

❌ ② 회사 이익 우선 (×, by helping workers or customers achieve their goals)

❌ ③ 겸손이 해롭다 (×, humility ultimately pays off)

✅ ④ 고정관념 재검토 필요 — 원문: We must reexamine this stereotype ← 정답
det.tip: reexamine this stereotype = 고정관념 재검토

ch: 내향적 사람보다 외향적 사람이 타인에게 봉사하려는 욕구가 더 강하다.
섬김의 리더십은 직원의 목표보다 회사의 이익을 우선시한다.
외향적 리더가 더 효과적이라는 고정관념은 재검토가 필요하다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 내향적 리더의 효과성에 대한 편견 재고의 필요성
det.analysis:
❌ ① 외향적 리더의 기업 경영에서의 중요성 — 글은 이를 반박함

✅ ② 내향적 리더의 효과성에 대한 편견 재고의 필요성 — 글 전체 주제 ← 정답

❌ ③ 섬김의 리더십의 철학적 기원 — 부분적 언급일 뿐 핵심 아님

❌ ④ 경영직에서의 외향적 성격의 통계적 우위 — 논거일 뿐 주제 아님
det.tip: reexamine this stereotype + servant leadership + humility pays off = 내향적 리더십 재평가

ch: 내향적 리더의 효과성에 대한 편견 재고의 필요성

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ 겸손에 뿌리를 둔 섬김의 리더십이 외향적 리더십에 대한 문화적 편견에 도전한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 기업 문화가 여전히 외향적 선호 — 현상 서술이지 요지 아님

❌ ② 내향적 리더가 항상 우월 — 과잉 일반화, 글은 '항상 그렇지 않다'고만 말함

✅ ③ 겸손 기반 섬김의 리더십이 편견에 도전 — 글의 핵심 메시지 ← 정답

❌ ④ 내향성=숨겨진 장점 — '숨겨진 장점'이라는 표현은 글에 없음
det.tip: 요지 = 외향적 리더십 편견 + servant leadership(겸손) = 재검토 필요

ch: 기업 문화는 내향적 리더를 뒷받침하는 증거에도 불구하고 여전히 외향적 성격을 선호한다.
통계적 연구는 내향적 리더가 외향적 리더보다 일관되게 우수하다는 것을 증명한다.
겸손에 뿌리를 둔 섬김의 리더십이 외향적 리더십에 대한 문화적 편견에 도전한다.
내향성은 현대 섬김의 리더십에서 숨겨진 장점으로 점점 인식되고 있다.
